findings.title: 24/151 order_items have NULL composition_snapshot — 2 of them are fiscalized
findings.details: Order #226 + #227 (today's RefundWithCounterEntry test fixture pair, fiscal_sequence_no=38, 39, source=pos type=1) carry order_items with NULL composition_snapshot. The 22 others are order_type=10 with empty source_surface — older fixture rows pre-V1.0.2 SSOT enforcement. NF525 invariant 'composition_snapshot non-NULL on fiscalized orders' is technically VIOLATED on 2 rows. Not user-impacting (test fixtures), but a strict Z-window audit could surface these.
findings.evidence: DB query: order_items LEFT JOIN orders WHERE composition_snapshot IS NULL AND fiscal_sequence_no IS NOT NULL → 2 rows (oi#161, oi#162 mapped to orders #226+#227).
findings.reproduction: php artisan tinker --execute='echo DB::table("order_items as oi")->join("orders as o","o.id","=","oi.order_id")->whereNull("oi.composition_snapshot")->whereNotNull("o.fiscal_sequence_no")->count();'
findings.recommendation: Cleanup migration: backfill composition_snapshot from items.composition + selected_options for legacy rows, OR add assertion in RefundWithCounterEntryService:149 that parent.orderItems[*].composition_snapshot is not null before mirroring. Defer to V1.0.X data-cleanup wave.

findings.title: Only Bowls + Frites have explicit wizard profiles in DB — sandwich/burger/menu_formule rely on derivation
findings.details: DB query: item_wizard_profiles WHERE is_published=1 → 10 rows, all template='custom'. Inspecting items: 2× Frites (Petite, Grande) + 8× Bowl variants. Sandwich Cayenne / Big Burger / menu_formule items have NO explicit profile row. Per task spec these should each have a published profile for visible/auditable composition rules. Code path still works via PricingService::composition_snapshot derivation, but the audit-spec target 'Wizard 4 templates' is data-incomplete.
findings.evidence: PUBLISHED wizard profiles (10): all bowls + frites only. Sandwich Cayenne / burger profiles ABSENT.
findings.recommendation: Seed published wizard profiles for sandwich/burger/tacos/menu_formule items in next catalog wave. Currently safe — composition derivation handles flow.
